title: The High-Protein Plant Board
seo_title: High-Protein Vegan Snack Board for 6–8: Shopping List
description: A high-protein vegan snack board for 6–8: edamame, smoked tempeh, lupini beans, roasted chickpeas, hummus, edamame dip, seeds and chickpea crackers.
hook: A snack board that fills people up: edamame, smoked tempeh, lupini beans and roasted chickpeas, with two bean dips and plenty of seeds.
why: Every item here earns its place with protein: soybeans as edamame and tempeh, chickpeas as hummus, roasted chickpeas and crackers, and lupini beans, which are among the most protein-dense beans you can buy in a jar.

Protein-heavy food can taste heavy, so the board leans on salt, spice and crunch to keep it fun. Briny lupini, spiced chickpeas and crisp celery and peppers keep people coming back, and lemon and tahini tie the dips together.

timeline.what: Sear the tempeh; thaw the edamame if frozen.
Drain and rinse the lupini beans; cut the celery and peppers.
Fill bowls with the dips and drizzle the hummus with tahini.
Add the edamame, tempeh, lupini and chickpeas around the bowls.
Fan the crackers; scatter the seeds; add lemon wedges.

faq.a: Yes, every item is plant-based. Check the labels on crackers, breads and store-bought dips, which sometimes contain butter, milk, honey or egg.
Large, firm yellow beans sold in jars of brine, popular in Italy and Portugal. They're eaten as a salty snack, often by popping them out of their skins.

faq.q: How many people does it serve?
faq.a: 6 to 8 people as an appetizer, on a 14–16 inch board.
